lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are organized in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gills, with the highest concentration of distinct nodes located between the mid-lateral line and the upper carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal spot patterns to form a structured grid of high-intensity nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibit a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, running parallel from the post-branchial region toward the posterior, demarcating the upper third of the shark's flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 small, irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the anterior half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller, low-luminance elongated silhouettes (commensal remoras) are visible positioned ventrally and trailing the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
